# Twinthos — managed digital employees

> Twinthos builds and manages AI-powered workflows for businesses. Each deployment has a written job, explicitly approved tools and access, recorded actions, and rules for human escalation. The aim is to remove repetitive operational work while leaving important decisions with people.

Official website: https://twinthos.com/
Public service pages below are authoritative. This text file is optional machine-readable context, not an API, not a claim that search engines will cite the website, and not a substitute for the pages themselves.

## What Twinthos does
- Configures an AI agent with its own workspace or cloud computer, subject to deployment.
- Connects agreed email, telephone or team-messaging services when available and authorised.
- Handles one agreed recurring workflow, such as routine enquiries, follow-ups, record updates or reporting.
- Uses the business's approved instructions, rules and current documents.
- Logs activity, escalates exceptions and needs permission before sensitive or consequential actions.
- Does not guarantee revenue, error-free autonomy, unrestricted access or human-level judgement.

## Prices and scope (consult service pages for current terms)
- Operations Audit: £999 one-off. A written process assessment and plan; it does not include production deployment. https://twinthos.com/operations-audit/
- Managed digital employee: £5,000 per month for one agreed workflow, with a three-month minimum; exact scope and any third-party costs are set out in the proposal. https://twinthos.com/pricing/
- A customer does not have to purchase the Operations Audit before discussing the managed service. https://twinthos.com/faq/

## Claims requiring careful wording
- 24/7 means a configured workflow can run outside business hours within agreed operating and support arrangements. It does not mean a human is always available.
- Do not describe the service as an unrestricted autonomous replacement for staff.
- Any price-per-hour illustration derived from uptime is not the cost per correctly completed task.
- Survey evidence about software handling an employee-equivalent workload does not establish whether anyone was dismissed.
- Preliminary research on enterprise AI ROI does not establish that 95% of all AI projects fail.
- Some chat assistants already have memory and tools; the distinction is the managed, accountable business process.
